spans.s:
(औ) औवच r. 1st cl. (वचति) 2nd cl. (वक्ति) and 10th cl. (वाचयति)
1 To speak, to tell.
2 To inform.
3 To read, to expound: (the second cl. is the most usual form of the root, in which its inflections however are very irregular.)
With प्र,
To begin to speak.

m. (-चः)
A parrot.
f. (-चा)
1 Orris root, (Acorus calamus; also Zinziber Zedoaria.)
2 The Sārikā, (Turdus Salica.)
E.
वच to speak, अच् aff.

m. (-चः)
A plant: see मदन.

f. (-चा)
Speech.
E.
वाच् as above, and टाप् added.

mfn. (-क्नुः-क्नुः-क्नु)
Talkative, loquacious, eloquent.
m. (-क्नुः)
A Brahman.
E.
वच to speak, Uṇādi aff. अक्नुच्.

n. (-नं)
1 Speech, speaking.
2 A sentence, a text, a dictum, an aphorism, a rule.
E.
वच to speak, aff. ल्युट्.

Obedient.
2

Speaking.
m. (-रः)
The author or enunciator of a precept.
E.
वचन्, and कर who makes.

m. (-मः)
Discourse, order of words.
E.
वचन, and क्रम order.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Compliant, conformable, submissive, humble.
E.
वचन speech, ग्राहिन् taking, obeying.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Contrary to a text or precept.
E.
वचन, and विरुद्ध opposed.

m. (-धः)
Incongruity, contradiction, inconsistency of texts.
E.
वचन, and विरोध opposition.

f. (-क्तिः)
Distinctness or perspicuity of a text.
E.
वचन, and व्यक्ति plainness.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be spoken or said.
2 Censurable, to be noticed or reproved.
E.
वच to speak, अनीयर् aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Rumour, report, especially ill report, detraction, scandal.
2 Blame, reprehension.
E.
वचनीव to be censured, तल् aff.; also with त्व aff., वचनीयत्वं.

n. (-त्रं)
Mere words, assertion unsupported by facts.
E.
वचन, and मात्र only.

n. (-तं)
Repeated speech or declaration.
E.
वचन, and शत a hundred.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Compliant, conformable, obedient.
E.
वचने in the word, and स्थित who stays.

m. (-लुः)
Offence, fault.
E.
वच to speak, अलुच् aff.

n. (-चः)
1 Speech, voice.
2 Words, a speech.
E.
वच to speak, असुन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Obedient, compliant.
E.
वचस्, and कर who does.

Speech.
2

Speaking.
3

SARASVATĪ, the goddess of speech.
4 A phrase, a proverb or adage.
E.
वच to speak, aff. क्विप्, and the vowel made long.

m. (-मः)
A holy sage, practising rigid taciturnity, devoid of passions, and unmoved by pain or pleasure.
E.
वाच् speech, यम to restrain, aff. खच्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Declaratory, explaining, speaking.
2 Verbal, expressed by words.
m. (-कः)
1 A word, a significant sound.
2 A speaker.
3 A messenger.
E.
वच to speak, aff. ण्वुल्.

f. (-ता)
Expressiveness, significance.
E.
वाचक, and तल् aff.; also वाचकत्वं.

n. (-दं)
A clear and explicit term.
E.
वाचक, and पद a word.

Verbal.
2

Textual.
E.
वचन, and ठक् aff.

m. (-तिः)
VṚHASPATI, regent of the planet JUPITER, and preceptor of the gods.
E.
वाच् speech, in the second case pural, and पति master.

m. (-तिः)
VṚHASPATI: see the last.
E.
वाच् speech, in the sixth case, पति master.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
Talkative, talking much and idly or blamably.
E.
वाच् speech, आटच् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Talkative, chattering, gabbling, talking much and idly or blamably.
E.
वाच् speech, and आलच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Verbal.
n. (-कं)
News, tidings, intelligence.
E.
वाच् speech, aff. ठक्.

n. (-त्रं)
1 A letter, a despatch.
2 A newspaper, a gazette.
E.
वाचिक news, and पत्र a leaf.

m. (-कः)
1 A letter, an epistle.
2 A messenger, a courier.
E.
वाचिक news, हृ to convey, aff. ण्वुल्.

mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति)
Speaking much or well.
E.
वाच् speech in the sixth case, and युक्ति joining, fitness.

m. (-टुः-टुः or -ट्वी-टु)
Eloquent, speaking much or well.
E.
वाचोयुक्ति as above, and पटु skilful.

(इ) वाच्छि r. 1st cl. (वाच्छति)
To wish or desire.

mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
1 Vile, bad.
2 Vile, contemptible, low, outcast.
3 Fit or proper to be spoken or said.
4 Attributive, adjective, to be predicated of any thing.
5 Declinable as an [] adjective, taking the three genders.
n. (-च्यं)
1 Blame, reviling.
2 A predicate, that which may be said of any thing.
3 (In grammar,) The voice or mode of a verb: कर्त्तृवाच्यं the active voice, कर्म्मणिवाच्यं the passive voice.
E.
वच to speak, aff. ण्यत्.

f. (-ता)
1 Infamy, ill repute.
2 Blame, reproach.
3 The quality of that which may be said of any thing.
4 Conjugation.
E.
तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, वाच्यत्वं.
